Name: Lapaat's Organized Greenhouse
Author: Lapaat
Description:
[size=6]ORGANIZATION[/size]
I wanted to create a greenhouse that could organize all of my crops. I made this for personal use, but I thought I'd share this for anyone who wanted it. Here's how I planned it.
• Right - 75 spots (3 spots for iridum sprinklers, 72 spots for Ancient Fruit or another cash crop, like cranberries.)
• Top Left - Wild Seeds (4 spots for each season and a spot in the middle for an iridium sprinkler)
• Bottom Left - 10 spots for the 10 continuous crops (Blueberry, Corn etc.; Grape is excluded since you can grow them with wild seeds)
• Mid Left - 24 spots for the 24 non-continuous, non-foraging crops (flowers, pumpkins etc.)
• Top Middle - 6 spots for each type of tree.
• Bottom Middle - Empty space for chests, seedmakers, etc.

Here's a sample layout:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/644-0-1477346987.png[/img]

[size=6]SPRINKLER EFFICIENCY[/size]
I also thought the 12x10 plot of farming space was awkward, since no matter how you lay out your sprinklers, you're guaranteed to be wasting sprinkler space. To fix this, I made every section even with the reach of iridium sprinklers.


[size=6]INSTALLATION (SMAPI not needed)
[/size]Back up your Stardew Valley Steam Folder.
Download and unzip the contents of the file.
Move the Greenhouse.xnb file to this folder: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps
If you get asked to replace, click 'OK'

[size=6]BUGS[/size]
• The tub of water at the north side of the greenhouse does not provide water.

• Configurable Machines does not work inside the greenhouse. It works outside the greenhouse however.

• Exiting the greenhouse is fine, but entering the greenhouse warps you to the default warp position for the greenhouse, which is in the middle of the modded greenhouse. I could fix the exit, but I don't know how to fix the entrance.
